before: Each token is one of the 64 codons or a special token.
after: Tokens are the 64 codons, 5 special tokens and one organism token per NCBI Taxonomy ID listed in the package's taxids.txt; config.json sets vocab_size 1736.
why: decodon_auto.py reads taxids.txt and adds an organism token per ID with tokenizer.set_organism_tokens(taxids); hf-config.json sets vocab_size 1736. Added quotes for both.

before: For embeddings and variant scoring, coding sequences read as codons, from a vocabulary of 64 codons and 5 special tokens.
after: For embeddings and variant scoring, coding sequences read as codons, from a vocabulary of 64 codons, 5 special tokens and organism tokens for NCBI Taxonomy IDs (vocab_size 1736 in config.json).
why: The README's 64 codons and 5 special tokens omit the organism tokens the wrapper adds. Added @hf-config as a source and quotes for set_organism_tokens and vocab_size.
